stem.text: Diagram 1 shows a lamp connected to a supply through two switches.

During repairs, an electrician mistakenly reverses the connections $\text{X}_1$ and $\text{Z}_1$, so that $\text{Z}_1$ is connected to the supply and $\text{X}_1$ to the other switch at $\text{Z}_2$, as shown in diagram 2.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram 1: a supply connected to a lamp through two switches. The first switch has contacts labelled X1, Y1 and Z1; the second switch has contacts labelled X2, Y2 and Z2.
Circuit diagram 2: a supply connected to a lamp through two switches. The first switch has contacts labelled X1, Y1 and Z1; the second switch has contacts labelled X2, Y2 and Z2.

stem.text: Which switch positions will now light the lamp?
